verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents a Supabase free plan or its limits. The only plan reference is that daily backups cover Pro, Team, and Enterprise, which says nothing about free-tier usability. Local development, keyless CLI use and Docker self-hosting are adjacent ways to prototype without paying, not a documented free tier.

support.subject: As a founder, a genuinely usable free tier lets me run real prototypes before paying
